design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (copay_assistance_and_discount_cards, Manufacturer Copay Card year-end world).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 6, 6]}. Assignment: copay_ext_card_counter_benefit (root) 6, copay_ext_card_paid_fill_reimbursement 6, copay_ext_card_period_opening 5, copay_ext_card_period_closeout 4.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: copay_ext_club_cash_price, copay_ext_club_renewal_fee, copay_ext_duplicate_fee_refund and their three tools (club price, renewal-fee payment, fee refund). Claimed here: the four card policies above and tools submit_copay_card_reimbursement_c6a4b4a1 (user), close_program_benefit_period_88a9291d, open_program_benefit_period_c8eb05d0, apply_copay_card_benefit_5e8b0a9f (agent). No task writes what the other's state sentences wait on: task 1 books no fee charge or fee refund; task 0 books no period entry or card benefit. M = 2, so no headroom is owed to later tasks; the union of both scopes is all seven extended policies, pairwise disjoint.
[Why a good test] The patient asks one thing: put her copay card on the adalimumab waiting for pickup. The counter benefit is fixed only after the account carries the opening entry of the period the claim date falls in (state); the card still shows the 2026 period; the new period is not credited until the account carries the 2026 closing entry (state, negated direction); and the closing entry is booked only after every fill of the card's prescription dated inside that period and settled by insurance alone carries a benefit entry on the program (state). The agent must see from the fill ledger that the 2026-12-09 vacation fill was settled by insurance alone, hand the reimbursement to the patient, then close 2026, open 2027 and bill the counter benefit, each on its own handling-time balance. Four computations with 21 declared factors, three history-dependent value flows.
[Problem-tree card] counter_benefit <- period_opening (value_input, gate counter_dollars_left, state, 'A counter benefit on a claim is fixed only after the budget account carries the opening entry of the benefit period the claim date falls in.'); period_opening <- period_closeout (value_input, gate carried_balance, state, 'A new benefit period is not credited until the budget account carries the closing entry of the period before it.'); period_closeout <- paid_fill_reimbursement (value_input, gate close_dollars_left, state, 'The closing entry of a benefit period is booked only after every fill of the card's prescription dated inside that period and settled by insurance alone carries a benefit entry on the program.'; the only write that puts a benefit entry on a fill already settled by insurance alone is the patient's reimbursement, the counter benefit being scoped to fills waiting for pickup). Single-writer proof for the state sentences: only submit_copay_card_reimbursement_c6a4b4a1 books a benefit entry on a fill settled by insurance alone; only close_program_benefit_period_88a9291d writes copay_benefit_period_closed and only open_program_benefit_period_c8eb05d0 writes copay_benefit_period_opened in this difficulty. Four-point test: ordering connectives (only after / not until / only after), record-visible states or a named business action, no tool/id/code token, hard requirement scoped to the period / every such fill. Owner of the reimbursement: the patient (user tool), handed over by the agent. False at opening: enrollment 6fdc3f98-bfa8-4690-80a3-cef1e889c759 benefit_period_start 2026-06-03 / end 2026-12-31, the only opening entry f1421296-2bc6-460b-b2e0-05421eb3c7e3 (2026-06-03), no closing entry, fill b08af753-9a51-4127-9b0b-ceffa89cc1c1 payment_basis insurance with patient pay 2,720.00 and no benefit entry. Order: reimbursement -> closeout -> opening -> counter benefit. Deletion sensitivity (sens.py): skip opening -> counter 2,710.00 becomes 137.25; skip closeout -> opening 6,765.69 becomes 6,342.50; skip reimbursement -> closeout 1,692.75 becomes 3,850.00.
[Base-invariant card] Benefit writes (steps 11, 17): copay_evt_benefit_application apply_only_when_active (card active), once_per_fill (no benefit entry names fill 7 or fill 8), retro_window (fill 7 day 57 of 180; fill 8 day 1 of 180; anchor rx_fills.event_date, inclusive), copay_agg_program_stacking (the card is the only program). Closing (step 13): copay_evt_benefit_period policy_scope. Opening (step 15): open_only_when_active (card active). Fill-count cap 13 not reached (7, then 8, then 9 entries).
[Business-object card] Reimbursement target: fill 7 of rx 3548120 (b08af753-9a51-4127-9b0b-ceffa89cc1c1) and its claim 11339b53-113a-423c-93ca-cd30fa3d7f2a (patient pay 2,720.00, 56-day vacation supply, deductible 0). Counter target: fill 8 (91981e2a-f2d8-4437-9e83-2b38e3e69b0a, 2027-02-03, awaiting pickup) and claim 5ff5ebd2-be21-42eb-9b08-c926dd934702 (patient pay 3,760.00, deductible 3,000.00, paid under the 2027-01-28 approval). Excluded: fills 0-6 already carry 800.00 benefits; the expired rx 3409957 fills (2026-01-14 .. 2026-05-06) predate the card and belong to another prescription; the 2026-01-14 deductible claim is exactly 12 whole months old and outside every 12-month window (near-miss).
[Factor card] Reimbursement (6): plan+cadence limit HDHP AND 8 refills -> 900 (multi-source, cross coverage; baseline 800 -> 1,970.00); standing allowance 7 entries -> 150 (-> 1,870.00); tenure 6 months -> 50 (-> 2,070.00); days-supply multiplier (parameter) 56 days -> twice (cross rx; -> 1,070.00); minimum pay 2,720 -> 10 (-> 2,175.00); late-claim handling (method: multiply by 0.95 / withhold a flat 20.00 / leave) 57 days -> flat 20 (-> 2,190.00). All baseline 795.00; gold 2,170.00. Closeout (4): share 8 entries -> 30% (-> 1,830.00); limit HDHP AND 3,000 deductible -> 1,000 (multi-source, cross coverage; -> 1,730.00); period length 6 months -> x6/12 (method; -> 1,555.50); expiry 5 months -> half (-> 1,555.50). All baseline 1,830.00; gold 1,692.75. Opening (5): annual max HDHP AND 3,000 -> 12,000 (multi-source, cross coverage; -> 5,565.69); term rule 3 months -> half (method; -> 12,765.69); carry absorption by linked plan (parameter) HDHP -> quarter of 137.25 = 34.31 (-> 6,800.00); adherence 8 entries -> 600 (-> 6,165.69); tenure 8 months -> 200 (-> 6,565.69). All baseline 9,600.00; gold 6,765.69. Counter (6): deductible left out by linked plan (parameter) HDHP -> half -> 2,260 (-> 2,950.00); limit 2,500 (-> 1,250.00); minimum pay HDHP 0 (-> 2,705.00); cadence 8 refills -> 50 (cross rx; -> 2,660.00); new-year allowance (method: flat 300 / 5 percent of the limited benefit / nothing) 33 days -> flat 300 (-> 2,410.00); renewal approval 2027-01-28 -> 100 (-> 2,610.00). All baseline 795.00; gold 2,710.00. benefit_remaining_usd 4,000.00 is a cache that equals the ledger; no rule reads it.
[Overwrites] reimbursement and counter benefit both replace 'The amount is the patient pay less patient_minimum_pay_usd, limited to per_fill_benefit_max_usd ... the patient pays the rest.' with their own ordering sentences (minimum pay after the limit); closeout replaces 'A period's dollars belong to that period only: ... never carried into the next period.' with the carry-forward sentence; opening replaces 'A program with a dollar budget opens a benefit period at activation and at the start of each new period ..., crediting annual_benefit_max_usd.' with its ordering sentence.
[Seed notes] Band k=3: Renata Mazur, phone 2065550367, DOB day 15, ZIP 43147, store 03762, rx 3548120 / 3409957, card member 3AS70148826, coverage member 3MW88410725. Plan year = calendar year (HDHP effective 2024-01-01); 2026 deductible met by the January 2026 claim, 2027 deductible 3,000.00 on the February claim. Automatic clauses: the 2026 period's end (2026-12-31) and the new calendar year are exactly the objects of steps 13 and 15; nothing else is due (card expires 2027-06-03, fill-count cap 13 not reached).
[Persona] Calm, apologetic librarian; volunteers only the surface goal (card on the waiting adalimumab, applied today); identity when asked (phone, DOB, ZIP; email spare); December described only if asked, without a figure; passive: files the reimbursement herself once told and handed it, lets the agent close/open the card year, ends when told the card is applied and the pickup amount.
[Standard solution / verification] reads: find_customers -> verify -> find_copay_enrollments -> find_copay_activity -> find_rx_prescriptions -> find_rx_fills -> find_coverage_plans -> find_coverage_claims -> find_coverage_prior_auths -> find_stores; writes: patient submits 2,170.00 on fill 7; close 1,692.75; open 2027-01-01..2027-12-31 with 6,765.69; counter 2,710.00 on fill 8 (she pays 1,050.00 at pickup). Verification: scratchpad sens.py with the gate's evaluator on replayed handling-time worlds reproduced every figure above; check_compute --task 1: COMPUTE OK.
[Draft recomputation from the visible context] Using the published rules, the finder returns and the persona, the same four writes and figures follow; the prerequisite sentences allow only the chain order.
[Difficulty closing record] Union of scopes = all 7 extended policies; task tools pairwise disjoint (3 + 4); every policy fires in exactly one task at its GT call; each task calls one owner=user tool; no handoff GT.
[Revision log, round 2 - policy-task audit] F-5: days_supply_coverage_of_limit relabelled parameter (multiplier 3 / 2 / 1); the late-claim factor became late_claim_handling, an honest method (multiply by 0.95 over 90 days / withhold a flat 20.00 at 31-90 days / leave as is), with the rule's ordering sentence and the declared overwrite's replaced_by updated; reimbursement stays 2,170.00. F-6: carry_forward_absorption re-keyed on the linked plan (quarter / half / none, parameter), so the fall-through is a real third treatment; opening stays 6,765.69. F-7: deductible_benefit_base became deductible_left_out_by_plan (half / whole / none left out by linked plan, parameter), and new_year_allowance_by_claim_date became the counter benefit's method factor (flat 300.00 / 5 percent of the limited benefit less minimum pay / nothing); counter stays 2,710.00. O-8: the closeout edge moved to the state form ('... every fill of the card's prescription dated inside that period and settled by insurance alone carries a benefit entry on the program'), fallback_reason removed; prerequisite_closure edge and order_uniqueness propagated. O-7: counter-benefit tool docstring reworded without an ordering word. Factor ids and labels propagated to computations[].factor_sensitivity and factor_trace; sens run reproduced every figure; full gate block re-run green.
user_scenario: You are Renata Mazur, 47, a school librarian in Pickerington, Ohio. You take adalimumab pens for Crohn's disease and you are calm but a bit worn out by insurance paperwork; you speak in full, polite sentences and apologise when you do not know something. The pharmacy texted you yesterday that your adalimumab pens are ready at the Pickerington Central store, and when you checked, the amount due was over three thousand dollars because your manufacturer savings card did not go through. You call with one request: "My adalimumab is waiting at Pickerington Central and my AdaliSure savings card didn't get applied - could you please put the card on that prescription so I'm not paying the full amount when I pick it up?" You want the agent to apply the card to that waiting prescription today; you are not asking for a quote only, and you do not know what the card should cover. When the agent wants to find you, you give your phone number, 2065550367. To confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1979-11-15, and your home ZIP code, 43147; if one more detail is needed, you give your email, renata.mazur@outlook.com. Only if asked: the prescription number on the box is 3548120; your store number is 03762; the member ID on your savings card is 3AS70148826; your insurance is Midwest Mutual HSA Choice, a high-deductible plan through your school district, and it is still active. If the agent asks about your December pens, you remember you got a two-month supply before holiday travel and that it cost a lot, you think over two thousand dollars, but you do not remember the exact figure. If the agent explains that you can claim money back from the card yourself for a fill you already paid, you say you had no idea and would like to do that; once the agent hands you the reimbursement request, you submit it exactly as the agent tells you and read back what the receipt shows if asked. If the agent says the card's year needs to be closed out or the new year set up on their side, you say that's fine, please go ahead. You never bring up December, reimbursements or the card's yearly balance on your own. Once the agent tells you the card has been applied to the waiting pens and what you will pay at pickup, you thank them warmly and end the call.
